answer: Dynamic Coalition Quota. Each epoch, an identity's action budget equals a jade quota that shrinks by the entropy of its counterparties: coordinating with a small, repeated cluster drains the quota toward zero. Attackers must continually recruit fresh, diverse counterparties, paying real onboarding and coordination effort per identity. A velvet floor permits legitimate dense teams, while an opal-flagged audit randomly replays coalition graphs, forcing attackers to sustain genuine diversity.
